note: F11. One entry per methodology. A new methodology is a new entry; a new engine is a new adapter file. `engine` names the adapter per product type; null means manual or not available in the MVP yet.

methodologies.name: Smoke
methodologies.description: The product starts and its main path answers.

methodologies.name: Negative
methodologies.description: Invalid input is refused with a clear message.

methodologies.name: Boundary
methodologies.description: Values at and just past the limits.

methodologies.name: Regression
methodologies.description: Behaviour that worked before still works.

methodologies.name: Security (access control)
methodologies.description: Requests without the right credentials are refused.

methodologies.name: Install / Uninstall
methodologies.description: Installer signature, install locations and clean removal.

methodologies.name: Compatibility
methodologies.description: Supported hosts, browsers or OS versions.

methodologies.name: Performance
methodologies.description: Response and processing times against a budget.

methodologies.name: Audio analysis
methodologies.description: Null test, latency, render comparison, loudness.

methodologies.name: Manual test
methodologies.description: Steps, Pass or Fail and a screenshot, in the same result format.
